d: Jason, Vickie, Thora and Tom join forces in the hope that their four brains can beat one - but that one brain happens to belong to a Chaser.
All that stands between Stuart, Claire, Jan and Alex is one of the country's finest quiz brains.

t: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip: Tim Brooke-Taylor and Graeme Garden
d: Two of the three Goodies, Tim Brooke-Taylor and Graeme Garden, get back into character to take an antiques road trip around Devon.
Amanda, Manish and Charlotte try to guess the familiar phrases hidden in animated clues, all trying to make it to the Super Catchphrase in order to win a grand prize of £50,000.
Bradley Walsh presents the big money quiz based on his own idea which features six players who cannot leave the contest until somebody wins.

Contestants compete across the series, scoring points by answering questions correctly. However, they must avoid the impossible answers, otherwise they will be eliminated from the show until the next day.
A family from Leeds try to top the tower as they seek a perfect ten and the big prize.
